for our salvation. Fear the Lord by pursuing Christ, giving your life to Him, and you will

Let's pray together. Heavenly Father, you are a good God, a holy God, a righteous God, and
a powerful God who has the right to punish us. And we confess that to you this morning.
We confess our own unrighteousness. Really, we confess our foolishness, but we praise
you, because you have not left us alone in our sin, in your majestic plan you sent to
save you for us, the God-man, Jesus Christ. And for that we give you praise. We pray that
our minds would not be distracted, that our hearts would not be troubled, but that we
would humble ourselves by coming before you and as believers, taking of your body and
the blood of Jesus Christ. We love you and we thank you for this good news that we're
to see. In Jesus' name we pray. Amen.
